clue.text: Gloomy face when Sergeant Major comes in

indicators.note: the sergeant major comes in, so his letters go inside the word for face

parts.note: a clock or watch face is its dial

explanation.surface: A gloomy expression appears as the sergeant major walks into the room.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Face' reads as an expression on the soldiers' faces, but it is a clock face.
explanation.definitionFit: Dismal and gloomy are synonyms, both describing a dreary, depressing mood or scene.

clue.text: Mortality figures are a complete write-off

definitions.meaning: read literally, the number of dead and the losses suffered
something totally useless or a failure

explanation.surface: Death statistics show a total financial loss.
explanation.definitionFit: Read literally the phrase is the toll of deaths and losses; as an idiom it means something utterly worthless.

clue.text: Start using the radio to get up to date

definitions.meaning: to turn a set's power on
to become alert and in touch with things, as a switched-on person is

explanation.surface: Turning the wireless on to catch up with the news.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means to power up a device and, figuratively, to become alert and modern.

clue.text: Nagging complaint teachers take to heart

indicators.note: the heart of the word teachers is its central letters

explanation.surface: Teachers taking a persistent grievance seriously.
explanation.walkthrough: 'take to heart' means the middle of TEACHERS, without its outer pairs.
explanation.definitionFit: An ache is a persistent dull pain, a complaint that nags.

clue.text: Doctor enters one minute after time for sacrifice

indicators.note: the doctor enters, so his letters go into the string built from the other pieces

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I
arriving after the appointed time is being late
MO, Medical Officer, is a crossword doctor

explanation.surface: A doctor arrives just after time to perform a ritual sacrifice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'after time' means late, as when one arrives after the appointed hour; 'enters' places the doctor inside the string.
explanation.definitionFit: To immolate is to kill as an offering, especially by burning, which is a sacrifice.

clue.text: Coup causes slave owrer to have apoplexy

parts.note: the owner of a slave is the master
apoplexy is the old term for a stroke

explanation.surface: A rebellion gives a plantation owner a seizure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Coup' suggests a seizure of power, but here it is a brilliant move.
explanation.definitionFit: A coup in its sense of a brilliant success is a stroke of genius.

clue.text: Aware of ducks around the Northern Territory

indicators.note: the zeros are placed around the territory's abbreviation

parts.note: a duck is a score of nought in cricket, so two ducks are O and O
NT is the abbreviation for Australia's Northern Territory

explanation.surface: Someone knowing about the waterbirds of northern Australia.
explanation.walkthrough: A duck is a score of nought in cricket, shaped like the letter O.
explanation.definitionFit: To be on to someone is to have seen through them, to be aware of what they are doing.

clue.text: Not a main route out of the country

definitions.meaning: split as ..., a minor British road rather than a main A-road

explanation.surface: Taking a back road to leave the country.
explanation.walkthrough: British roads are graded A for main routes and B for minor ones.
explanation.definitionFit: Split, the letters are a B-road, a minor British road; whole, the word means overseas.

clue.text: Save earlier part under the church

indicators.note: in a down clue, a piece under another is written after it

parts.note: ex means former or earlier
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: Rescuing an earlier section stored beneath the church.
explanation.definitionFit: Save, as a preposition, means apart from or but, the same as except.

clue.text: An entitlement is quite in order

parts.note: a right is something one is entitled to

explanation.surface: Claiming an entitlement is perfectly proper.
explanation.definitionFit: Aright is an adverb meaning correctly or properly, so things set aright are fully in order.

clue.text: Mysterious secret broadcast about love

indicators.note: the scrambled letters go about, that is around, the letter for love
broadcast seed is scattered, so the letters of secret are thrown into a new order

parts.note: the fodder as the setter needed it, with an I that the printed clue lacks
love is zero in tennis, written as the letter O

explanation.surface: A secret transmission about love is shrouded in mystery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broadcast' scrambles the fodder to ESTERIC and 'about' wraps it round O; but SECRET alone gives only six letters, so the clue as printed is an I short.
explanation.definitionFit: Esoteric knowledge is understood only by a select inner circle, so it is obscure and mysterious to everyone else.

clue.text: Where to put shoe polish when down at heel

definitions.meaning: literally, on the upper leather of a pair of shoes

explanation.surface: Advice on polishing shoes for someone who is hard up.
explanation.definitionFit: Literally the phrase places polish on a shoe's top leather; as an idiom it means penniless and shabby.

clue.text: Mad to get an engine

definitions.meaning: short for locomotive, a railway engine

explanation.surface: Someone driven crazy by acquiring a railway engine.
explanation.definitionFit: One word serves as Spanish-derived slang for crazy and as the clipped form of locomotive, a railway engine.

clue.text: Tin always causes a derogatory smile

parts.note: Sn is the chemical symbol for tin
e'er is a poetic contraction of ever, meaning always

explanation.surface: A tin of something always gets a scornful look.
explanation.walkthrough: SN is tin's chemical symbol; EER is the poetic E'ER, ever.
explanation.definitionFit: A sneer is a scornful, mocking curl of the lip, a contemptuous smile.

clue.text: Criticise vehicle parking

parts.note: a car is a vehicle
P is the road-sign abbreviation for parking

explanation.surface: Complaining about the way a vehicle has been parked.
explanation.definitionFit: To carp is to find fault and complain pettily, which is to criticise.

clue.text: Sedate way to get assistance

parts.note: St is the abbreviation for street, a way
aid is help or assistance

explanation.surface: A calm, steady route to getting help.
explanation.definitionFit: Staid and sedate both describe someone sober, settled and unadventurous.

clue.text: Woodland deity inflated by each hymn of praise

indicators.note: the god's name is swollen by having letters put inside it

parts.note: Pan is the Greek god of woods and shepherds

explanation.surface: The woodland god Pan swells with each song of praise.
explanation.definitionFit: A paean is a song of triumph or thanksgiving, a hymn of praise.

clue.text: Filming celebrity associated with meteoric career

parts.note: shooting a film is filming it
a star is a famous person

explanation.surface: A film star is linked with a career that rocketed upward.
explanation.definitionFit: A shooting star is a meteor, and figuratively a person whose rise to fame is swift but brief.

clue.text: Church house produces a paper to crack evil

indicators.note: the paper breaks into the word for evil, splitting it open

parts.note: vice is wickedness, evil
a rag is a disparaging word for a newspaper

explanation.surface: A church residence prints a newspaper to expose wrongdoing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rag' is a disparaging word for a newspaper, and 'to crack' means split open.
explanation.definitionFit: A vicarage is the house provided for a parish vicar, a church-owned residence.

clue.text: The commander was apparently with the Light Brigade

definitions.text: The commander was apparently with the Light Brigade

parts.words: The commander was apparently with the Light Brigade
parts.note: the leader of a unit was in the famous Charge of the Light Brigade, read as a phrase for being the one giving orders

explanation.surface: A historical note that the commander rode with the Light Brigade.
explanation.walkthrough: The Charge of the Light Brigade was a disastrous British cavalry attack in the Crimean War; anyone with the brigade was literally in the charge.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone in command is the person running things, and those with the Light Brigade were literally in its famous charge.

clue.text: Diarist set on producing a thesis

indicators.note: producing suggests the letters are worked up into something new

explanation.surface: A diary-keeper carries on writing until a doctoral thesis emerges.
explanation.walkthrough: 'producing' rearranges the twelve letters of DIARIST SET ON.
explanation.definitionFit: A dissertation is a long academic essay written for a degree, which is a thesis.

clue.text: Ampersand inserted in computer memory by chance

indicators.note: the ampersand's word is placed inside the memory abbreviation

parts.note: ROM is read-only memory
the ampersand symbol stands for the word and

explanation.surface: A stray ampersand finds its way into a computer's memory by accident.
explanation.definitionFit: Something random happens without pattern or plan, purely by chance.

clue.text: Light lunch leads to a quarrel at home

parts.note: a tiff is a minor quarrel
to be in is to be at home

explanation.surface: A snack at midday causes a domestic squabble.
explanation.walkthrough: TIFFIN is a word from British India for a midday snack.
explanation.definitionFit: Tiffin, from British India, is a light midday meal or snack.

clue.text: Revolutionary centre created by Fascist powers

definitions.meaning: the line about which something rotates
the WWII alliance of Germany, Italy and Japan

explanation.surface: A revolutionary headquarters set up by fascist states.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both the line a spinning body turns about and the WWII alliance of Germany, Italy and Japan.

clue.text: Point to an old weapon-a sharp point

parts.note: S is south, one of the compass points
a pike is a long spear once carried by infantry

explanation.surface: Pointing to an antique weapon with a sharp tip.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Point' is a compass point, here S for south.
explanation.definitionFit: A spike is a thin pointed piece of metal or wood, a sharp point.

clue.text: Composer awarded academic and civil honours

parts.note: BA, Bachelor of Arts, is an academic degree
CH is Companion of Honour, a British civil honour

explanation.surface: A composer receives academic and state honours.
explanation.walkthrough: CH, Companion of Honour, is a British order awarded for service to the arts or public life.
explanation.definitionFit: Johann Sebastian Bach was the German Baroque composer of the Brandenburg Concertos.

clue.text: Hard rain is welcome

definitions.meaning: pellets of ice falling as precipitation

explanation.surface: Heavy rain being greeted gladly.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means frozen pellets of precipitation and, as a verb, to greet or acclaim.

clue.text: That fellow is commonly a cup-bearer

parts.note: he refers to a male person
in dialect or nonstandard speech, be is used for is

explanation.surface: That man is, in common speech, someone who carries cups.
explanation.walkthrough: In Greek myth Hebe was cup-bearer to the gods on Olympus.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth the goddess of youth served nectar to the Olympian gods as their cup-bearer.

clue.text: A punctured tyre is indeed!

parts.note: a flat tyre has lost its air, and the exclamation hints at a person likewise let down and dispirited

explanation.surface: An exclamation on discovering a flat tyre.
explanation.walkthrough: The word describes both a tyre with its air let out and a person feeling dispirited, which the exclamation mark points to.
explanation.definitionFit: A punctured tyre has lost its air, and the same word means a person whose spirits have sunk.

clue.text: Put right by a couple of engineers

parts.note: RE stands for the Royal Engineers, a British army corps
a pair is a couple

explanation.surface: A fault fixed by two engineers.
explanation.walkthrough: RE is the Royal Engineers, a corps of the British Army.
explanation.definitionFit: To repair something is to mend it, restoring it to working order.

clue.text: Foolish advice to the over-zealous carer

definitions.meaning: split in two, the word tells someone who fusses too much to worry about things less

explanation.surface: Telling a fussy nurse that they are being silly.
explanation.definitionFit: Mindless means acting without thought, and split in two it tells a fussy carer to worry less.

clue.text: Strict cleric retiring in the diocese

indicators.note: the reversed cleric sits in the diocese word

parts.note: a bishop's see is his diocese

indicators.note: retiring means drawing back, so the cleric's letters run backwards

parts.note: Rev, short for Reverend, is a cleric

explanation.surface: A strict clergyman retires within his diocese.
explanation.walkthrough: 'retiring' turns REV into VER, which goes into SEE.
explanation.definitionFit: Severe and strict both describe someone harsh and uncompromising in discipline.
